name: SpotOn
oneLiner: Restaurant POS and software company whose SpotOn Loyalty program runs inside the SpotOn POS, online ordering and the GoTo Place guest app.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small multi-unit groups already running on, or moving to, SpotOn POS.

updates.text: Added SMS text messaging to its marketing suite, working alongside SpotOn Loyalty trigger-based deals and the campaign creator; guests opt in through loyalty, reservations or online ordering. Same quarter: Mobile Pay & Review, a two-way OpenTable integration, and Profit AI (general availability planned by year-end 2026).

features: Points earned per visit or per dollar spent, applied automatically at checkout
Guest sign-up through the POS, online ordering, the website, the GoTo Place app or a shareable link; check-in at the POS, guest-facing display, handhelds or app
Automated deals for sign-ups, birthdays, first check-ins and lapsed guests
Email and SMS campaigns to guests who joined the program
Dashboard for rewards, branding and results: loyalty spend, top customers and which rewards drive results
Rewards redeemable in store, online and in the app
Integration with SpotOn POS, SpotOn Order and reservations

pricing.text: SpotOn Loyalty is $65 per month when added to SpotOn POS. POS plans: All-In $0 per station per month (hardware included; 2-year minimum term and processing minimums), POS Essentials $55 per station per month (month-to-month; hardware bought separately), Build Your Own custom pricing for multi-unit and enterprise. No free trial; Get a demo.

notes: spoton.com could not be fetched from this session; pricing and features come from search snippets of spoton.com pages. Original's '$0 to $135+/month' POS tiers dropped (current pricing page shows different plans). Win-back automation is mentioned only by third parties, so it was left out. Sweet Chick, Francie and Terzo appear as July 2026 customers only in an aggregator profile, so they were not used. 2026-11: spoton.com/solutions/loyalty/, /pricing/ and the Q2 2026 blog post fetched directly. The loyalty page now lists automated deals for lapsed guests, so win-back is confirmed on SpotOn's own page. G2 rates SpotOn's restaurant POS listing (no separate loyalty listing) 4.4 from about 240 reviews, per g2.com search snippets.
pros: Loyalty runs inside SpotOn POS: setup happens in the POS and rewards apply automatically at checkout
Guests can join through the POS, online ordering, the website, the GoTo Place app or a sign-up link
Automated deals for sign-ups, birthdays, first check-ins and lapsed guests
Every sign-up becomes a contact for email and SMS campaigns (SMS added in July 2026)
A flat, published price: $65 per month added to SpotOn POS

cons.text: Sold as an add-on to SpotOn POS, so restaurants on another POS would need to switch systems to use it
No free trial; you evaluate it through a demo
The All-In POS plan carries a 2-year minimum term and processing minimums
Built for independents and small groups on SpotOn POS, so larger chains on another POS may need a standalone loyalty platform
